mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters signals weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate earnings growth and compresses equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 falls for two consecutive quarters
failure_condition: S&P 500 posts positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of triggered episodes, or the mechanism fails during a simultaneous monetary easing cycle.

mechanism_narrative: A 100-basis-point increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over a three-month window signals a tightening monetary stance, raising discount rates and reducing present value of future cash flows, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered episodes, or the mechanism fails when unemployment rises above 6.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 6.5% for three consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which reduces consumer spending and corporate profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered episodes, or the mechanism fails during a simultaneous acceleration in industrial production.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the industrial production index (INDPRO) below its 12-month moving average for four consecutive months signals weakening manufacturing activity, which reduces corporate earnings and compresses equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 posts positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of triggered episodes, or the mechanism fails during a simultaneous monetary easing cycle.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal savings (RSAFS) above its 12-month moving average for three consecutive months signals elevated precautionary savings, which reduces consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered episodes, or the mechanism fails during a simultaneous acceleration in industrial production.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 6.5% for three consecutive months combined with a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below its 12-month moving average for four consecutive months signals deteriorating labor and manufacturing conditions, which reduces consumer spending and corporate profit margins, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE > 6.5% for 3 consecutive months AND INDPRO < 12-month MA for 4 consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 posts positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of triggered episodes, or the mechanism fails during a simultaneous monetary easing cycle.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) below its 12-month moving average for six consecutive months signals easing inflationary pressures, which reduces the urgency for aggressive monetary tightening and supports corporate profit margins, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of triggered episodes, or the mechanism fails during a simultaneous acceleration in unemployment.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) above its 12-month moving average for four consecutive quarters signals strengthening aggregate demand, which boosts corporate earnings growth and expands equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 posts negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of triggered episodes, or the mechanism fails during a simultaneous monetary tightening cycle.
